production_survey.semantic_review_scope: Targeted production functions named in contracts; remaining hits are a search index, not line-by-line semantic review.

contracts.title_ar: الإعادة العامة تحفظ البقايا فقط
contracts.implemented_behavior: Generic restoration and noninjective erasure results, with Mathlib metric/coding results later in the same file.
contracts.boundary: No noun/gender/number/weak-class analyzer; linguistic licensing is explicitly outside these edit-restoration instantiations.

contracts.title_ar: شهادة الحوكمة مشروطة برايات معطاة
contracts.implemented_behavior: Typed residuals and certificate gating from supplied flags. All six Lean files in this repo concern the judgment/governance/rank model.
contracts.boundary: No Arabic morphology objects. residual_persistence assumes the preservation condition it concludes; other theorems enforce declared gating, not truth of the flags.

contracts.title_ar: التعريف في12Rabi: معجم وقرينة وافتراض نهائي
contracts.implemented_behavior: Supplied proper/pronoun POS, fixed pronoun/demonstrative sets and article-like prefix produce definite/ambiguous records; otherwise the default is indefinite and closed.
contracts.boundary: No Lean proof. No general idafa analysis in this function; absence of article is not a licensed negative fact.
counterexamples_from_static_review: An unlisted unmarked proper noun without its POS receipt falls through to indefinite.

contracts.title_ar: الجنس في12Rabi متعدد الحقول لكن لا استقلال لمصدره
contracts.implemented_behavior: Finite lexical exceptions, a supplied morph.gender feature and suffixes ة/ات/ى/اء determine several output gender axes; some unknowns remain unresolved.
contracts.boundary: The named axes are useful data separation, but a supplied feature or marker is often copied into lexical/syntactic/referential fields. No semantic inference or source attestation is proved.
counterexamples_from_static_review: A nonlexicalized word ending اء can be marked feminine even when its suffix belongs to a masculine plural or original root.

contracts.title_ar: العدد في12Rabi لا يفحص معظم قواعده المسماة
contracts.implemented_behavior: Digit/numeral tables and next-token morphology fill count records;3..10 checks a finaltaa against supplied counted gender. Other ranges mainly return rule names.
contracts.boundary: No Lean. n>=20 is uniformly tamyiz in _finalize, contradicting100/1000. The n20..90 gender branch includes nondecades, and n91..99 reaches the100plus label. Compound unit/ten readings and noun gender-of-singular are not acquired.
counterexamples_from_static_review: noun مسلمين or بساتين passes the ين dual heuristic and yields size2.
n=100 gets tamyiz in _finalize but a genitive-idafa label in _evaluate_agreement.
n=21 is labeled gender-neutral; n=91 reaches100plus.

contracts.title_ar: قواعدL12 افتراضات شكلية لا إسناد معجمي
contracts.implemented_behavior: Uses upstream kind/derivation plus prefix/suffix cues; noun ة or named weights→feminine, otherwise masculine; ان/ون/ات→dual/plural, some ين unresolved, otherwise singular.
contracts.boundary: No Lean; upstream feature receipt and heuristic defaults must remain distinguishable. The default is not an acquired negative fact.
counterexamples_from_static_review: حمزة ends in ة but is a masculine proper-name reading.
شمس/يد with no supplied lexical gender reach the masculine fallback.
أبيات ends ات but its taa is original, so suffix alone cannot establish sound feminine plural.

contracts.title_ar: إزالة الحركات تمحو تمييز ين
contracts.implemented_behavior: Article-prefix Bool, suffix number extractor checking stripped dual suffixes before plural suffixes, then masculine/singular defaults.
contracts.boundary: No Lean; after stripping vowels the dual ين case wins before any masculine-plural ين reading can be considered.
counterexamples_from_static_review: مُسْلِمِينَ and مُسْلِمَيْنِ lose their distinguishing vowels and both enter the dual branch.
The lack of initial ال is represented as definiteness=False even for a proper name or pronoun.

contracts.title_ar: المنقوص أمثلة مودعة في جدول
contracts.implemented_behavior: A short DataFrame seed for قاض/داع/ماض with supplied roots and descriptive features, passed through reconstruction.
contracts.boundary: Not an independent manqus classifier; seed labels and morphological statements are source data, not a theorem about any new word.

contracts.title_ar: التصنيف الصريح للّفيفPython ويخلط الهمزة بالعلة
contracts.implemented_behavior: Classifies supplied root positions, then generates specialized strings. The weak set includesو/ي plus four hamza shapes; unusual position combinations can fall back to SAHIH.
contracts.boundary: Do not transfer this weak set, fallback or unconditional generation. Most weak-past/present branches ignore the requested form and supplied lexical bab is absent.
counterexamples_from_static_review: سأل is labeled AJWAF because أ belongs to WEAK_CONSONANTS.
Positions(0,1) fall back to SAHIH while weak_positions remains nonempty.
All AJWAF present forms use longو in this implementation; this does not cover باع→يبيع.

contracts.title_ar: مولد الجمع يركب صيغة معطاة ولا يثبتها معجميا
contracts.implemented_behavior: Appends ون/ات to a generated active-participle stem; broken-plural generation uses one فُعَلاء template from a supplied triliteral root.
contracts.boundary: Not general singular-to-plural inversion, no noun eligibility or lexical plural attestation, no masculine/feminine semantics proof.

contracts.title_ar: alasmaa: صفوف مقفلة لا تعميم جنس وعدد
contracts.implemented_behavior: Only nominal_path plus exact normalized الصالحات→feminine or رحماء→masculine activates a gender result.
contracts.boundary: No Lean. Locked lexical witnesses are reusable as explicit source descriptions, not general induction.

contracts.title_ar: alasmaa: العدد النحوي في صفين
contracts.implemented_behavior: The same two normalized surfaces get plural; stage15_gender is intentionally ignored for activation.
contracts.boundary: Good field separation, but only two deposited readings; no general dual/singular/plural parser.

contracts.title_ar: alasmaa: علاقة العدد والمعدود في سياق مقفل
contracts.implemented_behavior: Four locked context rows for ثلاثة أيام, سبعة in the specified context, and a ten-token tract ending تلك عشرة كاملة; stage16 ignored.
contracts.boundary: Does not implement general number parsing, compositional agreement, or counting entities. Keep exact contextual provenance.

contracts.title_ar: alasmaa: تصريف اسمي ومعجم محدود وعكس يختار الأول
contracts.implemented_behavior: Caller-supplied case/definiteness/number/gender choose suffixes, or a deposited NounEntry chooses a stem; reverse index uses setdefault for one reading.
contracts.boundary: Raw API does not license a plural class; dual oblique suffix has kasra beforeya instead of the expectedfatha+sukun. Entry API appends ordinary vowel/tanwin to every dual/plural base. setdefault loses colliding readings.
counterexamples_from_static_review: The table _DUAL_SUFFIX uses KASRA+ين for oblique dual.
A dual entry base ending ان receives the ordinary singular tanwin through _inflect_noun_entry.

contracts.title_ar: Salehan: جدول جمع التكسير يتضمن جمعا سالما
contracts.implemented_behavior: Exact dictionary lookup over known singular/plural pairs, optionally augmented fromJSON; returnsNone if unknown.
contracts.boundary: No Lean generation or lexical theorem; certainty is stored/default numeric data. The class name does not certify all rows as broken plurals.
counterexamples_from_static_review: The known dictionary includes كَلِمة→كَلِمات in BrokenPluralTransformer.

contracts.title_ar: Salehan: agreement يفحص الحالة والعلامة فقط
contracts.implemented_behavior: The executable comparison checks irab_case and irab_marker.
contracts.boundary: Despite the docstring naming gender/number/case, it does not read gender or number; do not count it as their implemented checker.

contracts.title_ar: Qeyas يميز الجنس والعقل لكن من معجم مسبق
contracts.implemented_behavior: Distinct grammatical-gender/rationality values and fixed lemma groups, plus soft priors for ambiguous groups; lookup returns first matching group.
contracts.boundary: No Lean. Useful axis separation, but category labels/weights are supplied lexicon priors. A normalization match does not prove the intended reading.

contracts.title_ar: Bayan يودع صيغ الجمع كأوزان
declarations: sound plural and broken plural pattern entries
contracts.implemented_behavior: Named sound-plural suffix patterns and ten common broken-plural shape patterns with noun/plural metadata.
contracts.boundary: Non-Lean pattern declarations; matching a shape does not establish noun sense, lexical plurality, gender or a singular-plural correspondence.

contracts.title_ar: دستور الاسم فيMahdi يحول خواصا معطاة
contracts.implemented_behavior: Maps closure.features strings for number,gender,definiteness to enums; absent keys becomeUNKNOWN.
contracts.boundary: No Lean and no text acquisition. The construct label maps to a definite-idafa value without checking its complement in this function.

contracts.title_ar: Algebra يعيد حساب إيداع العدد
contracts.implemented_behavior: Reads a deposited four-row count table, derives outcome distributions from prescribed class-to-counted-form labels, then computes entropy/refinements.
contracts.boundary: Non-Lean and explicitly no new measurement. The expected grammatical outputs are inputs to the count construction, not learned from new texts.

contracts.title_ar: Algebra يختبر قرائن المناوبة على مدونة
contracts.implemented_behavior: Regex-based corpus protocol collects long/short hollow-like alternating frames, includes deletion as an observed witness, and reports prefix-stripping ambiguity.
contracts.boundary: Research measurement code, not a Lean theorem or exact lexical classifier. The protocol explicitly admits clitic/root ambiguity; no fresh run or accuracy claim here.

contracts.title_ar: Algebra: ناقص الفعل في المناوبة لا المنقوص الاسمي
contracts.implemented_behavior: Collects final-radical appearance/deletion alternations in explicit regex scope.
contracts.boundary: Distinct from nominal manqus; corpus coverage and broad claims are not revalidated by this static audit.

new_nabt_law_boundary: None of these Python heuristics becomes Lean-verified merely by being copied or calling a class Certified/Constitution.
Preserve the distinction between a stored lexical record, an explicit input feature, a surface candidate, a grammatical expectation and a verified contextual reading.
No default masculine/singular/indefinite inference; no collapsing of homographic yn or suffix/class/gender axes.
